answer_1.quote: A Text-to-SQL model translates natural language instructions to SQL queries ...
models: Various Text-to-SQL models (e.g., Guo et al., Bogin et al., Choi et al., Wang et al.)

answer_2.quote: The Spider official evaluation metric is exact set match (abbreviated as ESM) ... We also use single denotation accuracy and our proposed test suite accuracy as automatic evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: We focus on the queries ... randomly sampled and manually examined 100 of them. All of them are semantically equivalent to the gold query; in other words, we did not observe a single error made by our evaluation method.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators manually inspected model-predicted SQL queries and checked whether they were semantically equivalent to the gold SQL queries.
